status: Computed 2026-11-25, the confirmed cases recounted by the thread, referee pending: sampling hits cases and none is a copier. 17 sampled growths hold a made pattern after whose joining two parts of the second part's form are met more often than with it barred, than it leaves alone and than fully masked (5 in the main runs, where none was predicted; 12 in the follow-up runs), under 8 laws with takes that go by parent steps, 16 under parity. No candidate: each first-pattern form has confirmed cases for one second-pattern form. In all 17 the meeting runs through a start knot, so each is supplied, not made. Main runs cut to prefixes of their registered orders; one ran 81 minutes against the rule.
title: A copier by sampling: how often a growth, with every take left to chance, makes a pattern that leaves two of what it meets
